requirements.title: Determination of ALARM CONDITIONS and assignment of priority
requirements.description: Amendment: A CLINICAL THERMOMETER need not have a PHYSIOLOGICAL ALARM CONDITION.

requirements.title: Continuous operating conditions
requirements.description: Amendment (replace the first dash with): a temperature range of at least +15°C to +40°C

requirements.title: General requirements for mechanical strength
requirements.description: The tests of IEC 60601-1-11:2015, Clause 10 and IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, 15.3 shall be performed on the same sample of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER after the cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES.

requirements.title: General requirements for mechanical strength (emergency medical services)
requirements.description: The tests of IEC 60601-1-12:2014, Clause 10 and IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, 15.3 shall be performed on the same sample of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER after the cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES of 201.11.6.6 have been performed unless there are no cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES specified in the instructions for use. If more than one PROCEDURE is specified in the instructions for use, each PROCEDURE shall be so tested.

semantic_fragments.content: Clause 208.6.1.2 Amendment: A CLINICAL THERMOMETER need not have a PHYSIOLOGICAL ALARM CONDITION. This is an amendment added prior to the compliance check for IEC 60601-1-8:2006+A1:2012.

Clause 211.10.1.1: The tests of IEC 60601-1-11:2015, Clause 10 and IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, 15.3 shall be performed on the same sample of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER after the cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES. This requirement applies to the home healthcare environment.

Clause 212.10.1.1 Amendment: The tests of IEC 60601-1-12:2014, Clause 10 and IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, 15.3 shall be performed on the same sample of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER after the cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES of 201.11.6.6 of this document have been performed unless there are no cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES specified in the instructions for use. If more than one PROCEDURE is specified in the instructions for use, each PROCEDURE shall be so tested. A separate sample of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER [text truncated]. This requirement applies to the emergency medical services environment.

Laboratory accuracy test data (201.101.2): The clinical thermometer was tested at three temperature points (midpoint 37.0°C, upper limit 42.0°C, lower limit 33.0°C) of the rated output range (32.0°C to 42.9°C) under five combinations of ambient conditions (25°C/55%RH, 39.5°C/90%RH, 10.5°C/90%RH, 39.5°C/20%RH, 10.5°C/20%RH). All equation values (deviations) were within ±0.2°C. The RATED EXTENDED OUTPUT RANGE is N/A for this device.
